data.name: Bhagvant
data.long_meaning: The name Bhagvant is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘bhag’ meaning fortune, happiness, or god and ‘vant’ meaning carrier or possessor. Thus, Bhagvant can be translated as ‘the one who carries or possesses god.’ This name is often given to a child who is believed to be blessed by the gods or to invoke divine protection and blessings.
